newsitem.title: USA: Drypers starts offer for $45 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: Drypers starts offer for $45 mln of notes.

text.p: Drypers Corp said Thursday it is starting a cash tender offer for its outstanding $45 million issue of 12.5 percent senior notes due November 1, 2002.
The company also said it is starting a related consent solicitation for amendments to the indenture providing for the notes.
The dealer managers for the offer are Prudential Securities Inc and Credit Suisse First Boston.

The purchase price to be paid for each note tendered will be based upon a November 1 optional call price for the notes of $1,047 and a fixed spread over the yield on the 5 and 5/8 percent treasury note due October 31.
The company is offering to pay each qualifying registered holder of notes who consents to the proposed amendments an amount in cash equal to 0.25 percent of the principal of the Notes.
Drypers makes disposable baby diapers and related products.
